data.title: 波岛出海 · 工作室书桌旁的趴膝摸头撒娇
data.description: 同人社团工作室明亮的书桌旁，画完稿件的出海整个人趴在你的膝盖上。被你伸手抚摸茶色双马尾时，少女舒服得眯起圆圆的双眼，像只小猫咪一样蹭着你的大腿。
data.location: creative messy anime studio desk filled with drawing tablets and sketchbooks
data.action: kneeling beside partner chair, resting chin on his knees, smiling blissfully as he pets her twintails, eyes sparkling with total senpai worship
data.lighting: warm cheerful studio room lighting mixed with afternoon sunbeams
data.mood: sweet puppy-like adoration, blissful junior girlfriend warmth, pure domestic cheer
data.promptProse: Kneeling beside partner chair in a sunny room, Izumi Hashima rests her chin on his knee, purring happily as he pets her brown twintails.
